_comment: Rough placement of Caves of Qud's main-menu elements, copied to give the Raves title screen a matching layout WITHOUT redistributing any Qud art. Each value is a normalized [x, y, w, h] fraction of the window (0..1), measured from a 1793x997 capture of the 1.0.5 menu (build 2.0.211.59). MainMenu.gd reads the runtime copy at ~/Library/Application Support/RavesOfQud/title_layout.json (seeded from this file on first run, like overrides.seed.json). Re-measure and overwrite to re-tune.
